evidence: Modifies headers presync DoS protection logic in src/headerssync.{cpp,h} and src/net_processing.{cpp,h}.
rationale: Dynamically calculates headers presync DoS-protection parameters at runtime, eliminating parameter degradation over time and fixing a potential 50x memory bound inflation from system clock corrections. As the commit notes explain, the previous offline model 'actually got it (slightly) wrong by missing the fact that attackers are capable of strategically deciding to stop the attack in the middle of a batch,' while dynamic sizing adapts optimal bounds directly to chain state.
